session_notes.summary: P20-ACQUISITION owner delivered in commit 03e8cb94434adcea4923910eab975a55f7e2d7a3. opi-ai::retry gains the crate-private AcquisitionCore plus the public AcquisitionPolicy (max_retries = extra sends per payload variant, hint bound max_retry_delay_ms default 60s where 0 disables only the bound, injectable deterministic jitter seed), RetryAdmission (1-based retry_index + delay_ms) and AcquisitionSeal (PostHandoff/UnknownDispatch/Exhausted/Finished with as_str). Models::prepare_call_with_policy freezes the policy at preparation (prepare_call keeps AcquisitionPolicy::default, zero extra sends); start_attempt enforces cancel -> credential -> sealed -> readiness -> single-lease in that order with new typed ModelsError::RetryNotReady (zero dispatch before the admitted deadline; the deadline clears once elapsed) and ModelsError::CallSealed; AttemptStream records each item into the core: the first Ok item is the streaming-response handoff and seals acquisition retry (body/EOF/parser failures after handoff are final), an Err item is classified (retryable + budget -> admission with hint-priority delay, hint bounded by max_retry_delay_ms, else min(500ms*2^i,8000ms) with [0.75,1.0) SplitMix64 jitter; retryable without budget -> Exhausted; otherwise Finished), Ready(None) seals Finished when nothing was delivered, and Drop after a poll without an observed outcome seals UnknownDispatch while an unpolled drop only releases the lease (drop-before-send consumes no send). The reopenable successful lease is removed: a terminal outcome seals the call and a new logical call must re-prepare. agent_loop.rs loses its own retry scheduling (retry_attempt/max_attempts/delay_for_attempt/stream_delivered_content classification deleted): it passes config.retry.max_attempts as the per-call policy, schedules only prepared.retry_admission() attempts, waits cancellably on the SDK delay (during_retry_sleep select preserved), keeps AutoRetryStart/End events, retry-attempt/suppressed/exhausted/succeeded diagnostics (suppression now read from acquisition_seal()==PostHandoff) and parented Retry evidence records; loop_types mirrors the refusals as AgentError::RetryNotReady/CallSealed with diagnostics and exit-code mappings. PreparationEvidence::run_provider_call stays single-send (default policy) through the same mechanism; the summary ProductCompactionHooks::prepare new-call recovery loop, usage-unknown accounting (SummaryUsageUnavailable) and cancellation policy are untouched, so no sends stack beyond the frozen budget. Tests: retry_backoff gains 7 closure tests (real-adapter hint/readiness/frozen-payload, family backoff range, 1+N budget with exhausted seal, post-handoff and unknown-dispatch sealing, finished sealing incl. eventless EOF, cancelled token forbidding attempts); retry_agent gains exact-send-count episode proofs (3 sends with 2 admissions incl. no-stacking under max_attempts=1); reopen-dependent suites re-proven through real admitted retries (provider_collection admitted_retry_after_failure..., budget-clamp fail->retry episode with frozen compiled limits, bedrock Timeout episode with frozen SigV4 plus a separate provider-side fresh-credential helper, api_mapped RateLimited episode with auth resolved once and frozen bearer). Honest boundaries: seals are sticky with the first reason winning (a fully successful stream seals as PostHandoff; Finished is observable for eventless termini); admission breadth (409/5xx/x-should-retry, Smithy/Bedrock and Codex tables, quota/deadline enforcement) stays with 20.34/20.20/20.16; MockProvider counts stream_prepared calls so an unpolled dropped attempt still consumes a scripted mock response (no test depends on that discrepancy); no new workspace dependencies (jitter is an internal SplitMix64).

tasks.definition_of_done: Implement a private opi-ai safe Rust key/signing owner using unmodified crates.io rustls0.23.40 and aws-lc-rs1.18.2/aws-lc-sys0.46.0 public KeyProvider::load_private_key, SigningKey algorithm/choose_scheme and Signer::sign seams. Prove RDF-23 unencrypted two-prime RSA2048..8192 PKCS1/PKCS8 PEM/DER including e3 and supported P-521 PKCS8/SEC1 signing/verification, independent signature verification, wrong-algorithm/encrypted/malformed/wrong-key negatives and declared RSA1024/multiprime rejection without false success or secret leakage. No local FFI, OpenSSL LibCtx/EVP owner, crypto fork/namespace/root patch or third-party/pi-crypto build path is required. Review actual registry graph/features/checksums and upstream native C/FFI/assembly/build/proc/toolchain inputs; standard non-FIPS source-build evidence uses AWS_LC_SYS_USE_SYSTEM=0, records actual static source/CC outcome and excludes unreviewed system/bindings/version-skip/target replacements at controlled build/consumer gates. Cargo.lock cannot freeze external native provenance; untested unions/platforms remain OPEN. Permit native process-once CPU initialization/capability environment reads and OS entropy without global provider/config/env/subscriber mutation or ambient credential/trust/proxy discovery. Retain owned upstream keys/resources until synchronous native signing worker joins after caller cancellation, suppress late publication and distinguish between-operation cancellation from impossible hard preemption. Preserve existing HMAC/SHA/SigV4 and transitive ring coexistence. This is substrate for20.14 and later real ADC20.21.1; tests cannot require exporting a new public crypto API or claim full TLS/public/package/platform acceptance.

session_notes.summary: Delivered the external_account federation families and the cancelable executable supplier through the public path. Corpus: restored read-only npm tarballs (google-auth-library@10.6.2, gaxios@7.1.4) into a fresh temp dir (never executed, never committed) and verified every constant from source: baseexternalclient (STS grant urn:ietf:params:oauth:grant-type:token-exchange + requested access_token URN, default token_url https://sts.{universeDomain}/v1/token, workforce audience regex //iam.googleapis.com/locations/*/workforcePools/*/providers/.+ with workforcePoolUserProject only valid there and only without client auth flowing into the non-standard options form field, expires_in -> now+expires_in, 5min eager threshold, pendingAccessToken single-flight NOT ported [flagged]), identitypoolclient (file/url/certificate mutually exclusive pairs, format json needs subject_token_field_name, text default), file supplier (realpath+isFile, raw text no trim, json field), url supplier (GET with configured headers, gaxios retry config -> default budget), certificatesubjecttokensupplier (XOR use_default vs location, resolution order location > GOOGLE_API_CERTIFICATE_CONFIG > well-known CLOUDSDK_CONFIG|APPDATA|HOME/.config + gcloud/certificate_config.json, config cert_configs.workload cert_path/key_path, X509Certificate+createPrivateKey parse, subject token JSON.stringify of base64 DER chain with leaf-position rules, mTLS agent scoped to the STS exchange), awsclient + awsrequestsigner + defaultawssecuritycredentialssupplier (environment_id ^aws\d+$ with only aws1 supported, regional_cred_verification_url required with default https://sts.{region}.amazonaws.com?Action=GetCallerIdentity&Version=2011-06-15, region AWS_REGION>AWS_DEFAULT_REGION>region_url stripping the last char, creds env AK+SK(+token) > role list then {url}/{role} json, IMDSv2 PUT ttl 300 with token headers per supplier leg and no retry config on IMDS legs, SigV4 with service from host first label and x-goog-cloud-target-resource merged AFTER signing, subject token encodeURIComponent(JSON.stringify({url,method,headers}))), pluggable-auth-client/handler/executable-response (gate GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_ALLOW_EXECUTABLES===1 checked before cache read and spawn, timeout default 30s validated 5-120s at construction, argv regex quote-aware with outer-quote strip only, cache realpath/isFile/empty -> miss, malformed JSON cache -> ExecutableResponseError terminal, valid-but-expired/unsuccessful -> miss, response validation version/success required + version<=1 + token_type in {saml2->saml_response, id_token/jwt->id_token} + error code+message both + expiration_time required when output_file + isExpired on unix seconds, merged stdout+stderr via data appenders, nonzero exit -> ExecutableError, timeout -> kill child), oauth2common RETRY_CONFIG (retry:true + methods -> gaxios default budget 3/2/ranges/delays). Implementation: new auth/adc/{subject,external,executable}.rs (subject suppliers + rustls RootCertStore structural validation + identity re-encode + AWS supplier with single-send IMDS + js_encode_uri_component + SigV4 via the existing public bedrock::sigv4::sign_request primitive [service/chain reuse, not the profile/SSO/process chain]; coordinator with typed CredentialSourceInvalid/WorkforceProjectInvalid/SubjectTokenUnavailable/CertificateSourceUnavailable/AwsSubjectUnavailable/ExecutablesNotAllowed/ExecutableSpawnFailed/ExecutableFailed/ExecutableTimeout/ExecutableResponseInvalid{reason}/ExecutableResponseExpired variants; executable supplier reusing the aws process module terminate_tree_and_reap now pub(crate), process_group(0) + kill_on_drop + per-stream merged output). native.rs: external_account arm dispatches to the coordinator (impersonated_service_account stays FamilyNotAdmitted), ReqwestAdcTransport::with_tls for the certificate-scoped mTLS leg, AdcNativeInput.certificate_extra_roots_pem (test/pinned-deployment extra trust for the STS leg only), canonical-endpoint override now pins the external exchange too. auth.rs: ExternalAccountSupplier {File,Url,Certificate,Aws,Executable} + AdcCredentialSource::ExternalAccount{supplier,workforce_user_project}. test_support: portable_executable_script moves the unix/windows spawn split out of acceptance sources (the Phase 17 guard rejects cfg attributes there). Fixtures: synthetic non-secret openssl-generated X.509 v3 PEMs (CA + 127.0.0.1 server + two leafs + key; v1 drafts were rejected by rustls UnsupportedCertVersion and regenerated with basicConstraints). Tests: 33 new auth_contracts (config/workforce/confidential/Basic/options userProject/default+override endpoints/sts budget+rejection, file text-no-trim + json field, url supplier GET+headers+terminal status, aws fixed-vector subject decoded and verified incl. unsigned target-resource + session token in SignedHeaders, IMDSv2 flow with region strip and per-leg token, aws2/missing-url typed, certificate mTLS over a real loopback rustls server requiring a CA-chained client cert [plain transport untouched], config resolution order env-then-CLOUDSDK_CONFIG well-known, XOR, chain leaf-order rules, executable gate before cache+spawn with marker absence, fresh-cache no-spawn, stale-cache spawn with all five GOOGLE_EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT_* env vars + impersonated email, malformed-cache terminal, failure code+message, invalid token_type, missing expiration_time, version 2, nonzero exit with merged output, timeout kill at the 5s floor with frozen marker proving process-group reaping, parse-time 5-120s range) + 4 vertex through-Models (file supplier Bearer+provenance, STS failure -> zero generation requests, real executable end-to-end, aws env Bearer). Zero manifest/dependency/config changes. Dev incident (honest record): before the canonical-endpoint override covered the external exchange, one certificate test iteration POSTed once to the real https://sts.googleapis.com/v1/token with a synthetic subject token and received 400 (no credentials sent, no retry loop); fixed immediately by honoring the input endpoint override for every external source and re-verified on the loopback server only. Exec D.2 (7 lenses sequential, evaluator applied inline): 0 must-fix, 9 flagged_for_human (redirect-terminal for the URL supplier consistent with 20.21.1 fail-closed policy, revisit at 20.21.3; certificate keys limited to the frozen RDF-23 TLS profile - P-256 leaf keys typed KeyRejected where Node accepts any parseable key, revisit trigger a named EC workload need; chain structural validation via the rustls/webpki parser not full X509Certificate semantic parity; IMDS region/role strings not trimmed for byte parity; merged stdout/stderr reassembled per-stream not byte-interleaved; timeout test floor 5s with unix killpg and Windows taskkill /T /F tree reaping instead of job objects; child env = real parent env + the five additions matching Node semantics; output_file not-rewritten proven by absence of any write path rather than a byte-identity assertion; single-flight pendingAccessToken not ported, owner semantics unchanged), 3 rejected (aws-lc-rs unstable feature for X509 bindings; new public process-runner trait forbidden by the DoD; shell-based command execution). C.1a appends recorded with reasons (process.rs pub(crate) reuse, test_support platform split, fixtures dir).

evidence.Opi-Acceptance: P20-STORE delivered in commit 843cde1: opi-ai gains the mutation substrate (MutationQueue detached state machine with synchronous admission, store-wide generations, per-provider FIFO chains via predecessor-tail settling, per-provider revision bookkeeping, panic-to-Unknown with fixed non-secret details, unbounded receipts/reports by design) and the CredentialStore surface extension (modify: serialized read-modify-write with MutationSlotView re-reads, MutationDecision, non-secret MutationReceipt ACKs carrying Written/Deleted/Unchanged revisions, typed Failed{Store,Operation} and Unknown outcomes; mutation_barrier: synchronous same-store cutoff reported as pending/settled/failed/unknown plus fenced late writes, is_complete/wait without default deadlines, no auth started, no rotation aborted; MutationHandle wait-only cancellation; inert inline defaults for simple stores; queue-backed InMemoryCredentialStore reference implementation; CredentialStoreError Clone). Models::logout submits one serialized deletion and acknowledges exactly that receipt (new ModelsError::MutationOutcomeUnknown); Models::mutation_barrier shares the store cutoff across Models instances. Product bridge: KeychainCredentialStore splits KeychainCore and routes write/delete/modify through the embedded queue, each slot holding the cross-process fs4 lock across its full read-modify-write (marker+protected entry invariants and lock-free reads unchanged, host lock policy preserved); CredentialResolver::resolve_oauth (now Arc<dyn OAuthProvider>) runs rotation detached inside the slot: re-read under lock means a second waiter reuses the committed token with no second refresh, only the refresh HTTP exchange runs under the 15s network bound (lock waits and the ACK outside it), post-failure re-read under the slot reuses a concurrent writer's fresh token, timeout keeps its typed error, wrong-kind/no-entry report typed failures without writes, and a rotation queued behind a logout reports CredentialNeeded instead of resurrecting the replaced identity; /login persists through the serialized mutation before notify_success. Disclosed boundaries: receipts/revisions are an in-process view (cross-process serialization is the store's own fs4 lock; no cross-process receipt store), runtime death before settle leaves the handle unresolved by design (no claim the old token remains valid), late-write fencing reports rather than aborts, and the V-55 nine-flow login/refresh generation surface (20.23-20.31), AWS (20.19.x), ADC (20.21.x) and catalog publication races (20.32) stay open

mistral-conversations complete adapter delivered: public MistralConversationsChatApi (api id mistral-conversations, provider id mistral) through Models::register_chat_api with typed MistralOptions - tool_choice full enum (auto/none/any/required/named; omitted options stay off the wire), reasoning_effort none..max, prompt_mode reasoning. The simple entry maps tool choice and resolves the reasoning branch from the model record: explicit thinking-level maps send reasoning_effort (nearest supported after clamp, the none-level entry when thinking is disabled, 'high' fallback), mapless reasoning models send prompt_mode=reasoning, non-reasoning models send neither; the branch uses the new public ThinkingLevelMap::has_explicit_mappings so opi's synthetic identity default cannot masquerade as a source map. Sampling projects temperature and max_tokens only (stop/top_p/penalties stay off this wire per pi's payload builder); tools project strict:true by default with the converted schema. Prompt caching: prompt_cache_key + x-affinity gated on session id and non-Disabled retention, explicit x-affinity header wins and only suppresses the auto header. Response deadline covers only the header wait (default 60s, request.timeout override) - the stalled-body test proves the boundary. Replay normalizes tool-call ids to nine alphanumeric characters (strip, exact-length passthrough, SHA-256 derivation - pi's internal short hash is not wire-observable; collision retries) on assistant calls and paired tool results; message conversion collapses mid-convo system to the merged leading prompt, drops blank text, replays thinking chunks with prefix:false, keeps single text-only user turns as plain strings, sends image_url data URIs on image models with the omission placeholder otherwise, and renders tool results with the [tool error] prefix and (see attached image)/(no tool output) placeholders. Streaming: first non-empty chunk id as response_id, cached-token split (input=prompt-cached, cache_read=cached, cache_write=0, total fallback sum across the six-key detail family), empty content deltas skipped (GLM split guard), index-keyed tool accumulation with derived ids for the "null" placeholder and AIR-048 finalization, stop map stop/length/model_length/tool_calls, in-stream error and unmapped stops fail typed carrying the raw reason, missing finish reason fails typed, HTTP errors format 'Mistral API error (status): body' with the 4000-char truncation before the crate-wide sanitized-summary cap (429 keeps its retryable RateLimited identity). Callbacks: payload observer (replace-or-keep once per logical call, frozen across retries, validated) + response observer (status+headers before body processing) supported; raw-event and header-transform families reject typed UnsupportedCapability before dispatch (ONB-04); frozen TelemetryContext passes through by wrapping the attempt (P20-TELEMETRY consumer; no automatic spans). Observable result and failure: 静态 header 按大小写合并、null 删除非保护默认；Pi 为 resolved auth→model.headers→per-call→transform，Provider.headers 元数据本身不自动并入。Rust 按 profile/static→resolved auth→per-call→transform 一次，保护 identity/auth/host 等变更，合法字段实际到 wire；此保护及显式 profile 默认为记录过的安全差异。Bedrock 自定义 header 在 SigV4 前纳入签名，reserved auth/x-amz/host 不可绕过保护。每 payload variant 一次 onPayload，普通 HTTP retry 不重跑；唯一 strict 降级第二 variant 重跑且重验。HTTP onResponse 按 adapter 固定：支持的 chat 在 body 消费前（Mistral 在 HTTP success 检查前），image/classifier 在成功完整 JSON 之后，错误 HTTP 不概括为一定回调；Google 两 API 无伪造 headers callback，Codex WS 无伪造 HTTP response。十 chat 的 raw parsed events 在 normalize 前依序只读，unsupported 操作明确无此 callback；callback failure typed 终止，保留 dispatch/partial，不变为 retry/fallback/成功。telemetry recorder 不吞功能 callback 失败；canary 仅显式可信 raw 回调可见，不进默认诊断. Apply all source row evidence boundaries and later backend/RDF refinements. Host-impact clauses do not grant host delivery.
